version.changelog: 1.0.1 - Wordmark font name corrected to "Zilap Orion" (the logo now uses the house font when it is installed) 1.0 - First full release

version.author: TimTechlor
version.changelog: 1.07 - Sound engine recalibrated against reference recordings: 4-pole VCF at the TB-303 pole positions, much stronger resonance, lower cutoff floor (~100 Hz), decay range 25-570 ms, fast VEG sag after the attack (shorter, punchier steps), accent network (latch + RC) with audible accent tail, 6 ms release - SLIDE time now sets the arrival time (~95 %) instead of the time constant - Square with pitch-dependent duty; 7-tap half-band decimation - Hotter distortion (more drive and presence tilt) and +12 dB output make-up: 1.07 is noticeably louder than 1.0 - lower VOLUME if needed - New EQ defaults: drive EQ fully open, delay 300 Hz-2.8 kHz, reverb 300 Hz-2.5 kHz (header and INIT) - The preset bar shows the active preset again after loading a project - Fixes: same-pitch overlaps in HOST mode; held notes are released on transport stop; step at the loop end no longer fires twice; tie after All-Notes-Off no longer silent; UNDO restores the right bank and survives transport start; no hanging notes on SEQ OUT; MIDI transpose counts keys, not events; TUNING/FINE and MIDI CC act immediately; INIT resets all sound controls - COPY creates an undo point for the target bank - Wordmark font name corrected to "Zilap Orion" 1.0.1 - Wordmark font name corrected to "Zilap Orion" 1.0 - First full release

version.author: TimTechlor
version.changelog: 2.0.0 - First ReaPack release since 1.07. Renumbered from 1.5.0: ReaPack reads 1.07 as 1.7, so 1.5.0 would not be offered as an update. Includes all changes listed below. 1.5.0 - HOST mode aligned further with the Devil Fish MIDI In: note stack 10 deep (oldest falls out), sustain on CC 64 (gate stays on while CC 64 >= 64), accent velocity default 65 with the four Devil Fish thresholds 65/80/100/120 on a DF button; existing projects and presets keep their stored accent velocity 1.4.1 - HOST mode as the Devil Fish MIDI In: a note-on for a key that is already on is ignored (no retrigger, no hanging note); the first note-off ends it 1.4.0 - HOST mode: an overlapping note of the same pitch was struck again (replaced by 1.4.1) 1.3.4 - Persistent UI size and options; larger default, stable colours when zooming 1.07 - Sound engine recalibrated against reference recordings; slide time sets the arrival time; hotter distortion and +12 dB output make-up (noticeably louder); several HOST/SEQ fixes

version.author: TimTechlor

version.author: Tim Techlor
version.changelog: v1.5.0 - New name: TT-BPM2MS2HZ (formerly "BPM2MS2HZ Calculator"); file name and saved settings stay the same. - New look after the TT UI kit 7: panels, LED switches, tempo slider and value tables drawn like the TimTechlor plugins. - Every control has a tooltip; OPTIONS > TOOLTIPS ON / OFF switches them off (saved). - NEW: OPTIONS > AUTO FIT ON / OFF (default on): dragging the window edge rescales the UI to the new window size (25 to 400 %); the UI SIZE buttons 100 / 125 / 150 / 200 / 300 % resize the window. Saved. - Wide windows show the tempo panel and the table side by side. - Mouse wheel over the tempo slider: 1 BPM per step (Shift: 0.1 BPM). - Version shown in the window header.

version.author: TimTechlor
version.changelog: First release via ReaPack. - Element overrides table uses the full remaining window height - Draggable splitter between the font list and the element overrides

version.author: TimTechlor
version.changelog: v1.5.0 - NEW LOOK: panels, buttons, switches and the size slider now follow the TimTechlor UI kit 7. - NEW: every control has a tooltip; OPTIONS > TOOLTIPS ON / OFF switches them off (saved). - NEW: OPTIONS > AUTO FIT ON / OFF (default on): resizing the window rescales the content to the largest size that fits; the UI SIZE buttons 100 / 125 / 150 / 200 / 300 % set a fixed size until the window changes again. Range 25 to 400 %, saved. - NEW NAME: TT Theme Font Editor is now TT-THEMEFONTEDITOR. File name, action and saved settings stay the same. - The version is shown next to the name at the top of the window. - FIX: BAKE THEME right after the first change now finishes the bake after preparing the working copy (before, only the preview was made). - FIX: an incomplete working copy (a file that could not be copied or extracted) is reported and no longer marked as ready. - FIX: baking never deletes the previous export first: the old file is moved aside and only replaced once the new one is in place; if that fails, the old export stays. - FIX: write errors (e.g. a full disk) are detected; a plain theme is written to a temporary file, checked, and only then replaces the target, so no cut-off theme is left behind. - FIX: a missing or unreadable file inside a zipped theme, or a zip write error, stops the bake with "Baking failed: ..." instead of writing an incomplete theme. - FIX: selecting a font larger than 48 px (or smaller than 6 px) no longer changes it; at a fixed large UI size the window scrolls instead of cutting off controls. - NEW: BAKE TO chooses where BAKE THEME writes: CREATE COPY (default) makes a new theme file "<name> (TimTechlor)" next to the original, numbered "(TimTechlor 2)", "(TimTechlor 3)" ... if that name is taken, and never replaces an existing file; OVERWRITE ORIGINAL writes back into the theme you are editing and keeps its previous version as "<name>.bak". The choice is saved; the status line names the file that was written. - FIX: closing the window while the working copy is being prepared or a theme is being baked now stops the job cleanly: files are closed and no half-written theme or temporary file is left behind. - FIX: a change right after baking no longer races with the removal of the old working folder (the folder is renamed before it is deleted in the background).
